caller.author: BobLoukas
caller.text:
Really solid Bitcoin push here to break the intermediate trend and resume the secular bull trend.  
As is common in any new move, a nasty shakeout is likely, but I’d suspect it doesn’t come until later and from higher.

parent.author: BobLoukas
parent.text:
Very good setup here for Bitcoin to smash through the May highs and confirm a new bull market.  

More importantly, the recent 4-week consolidation means any solid push through the highs is very likely a fresh new move that has legs (vs a trap) that might not look back until the $90's.  

Failure to break through sets up a move back to the lows of the range.
